title: Accrued rewards can exceed the per-round cap and stall calculation
description: With 100 funded, a 50% cap and payout threshold 60, the first period accrues 50. Subsequent periods attempt 100 against cap 50 and abort without advancing the journal.
impact: Funded payouts can remain stalled until funding or cap policy changes.
exploit_scenario: No attacker required; ordinary low-fee and payout-threshold configuration triggers it. Twelve consecutive attempts reproduced.
recommendation: Design deterministic cap-aware allocation of existing carry and new earnings, with independent replay and fairness tests. Do not casually change the journal-bound threshold.
remediation: Proportional capped instalments preserve all unpaid credit; old successful uncapped ordering retained.

title: Six-hour scheduler can skip the next proposal slot
description: A previous proposal mined after its scheduled start makes the next fixed six-hour run too early. The minute payout job does not propose.
impact: A small timing difference can delay the next proposal by another six hours.
exploit_scenario: First proposal lands at t=10. The job at t=21600 cannot propose until t=21610 and has no timely proposer retry; it waits until t=43200.
recommendation: Separate six-hour earnings windows from frequent proposer retries keyed to nextProposalAllowedAt; keep proposer and keeper keys isolated.
remediation: Retry existing journal plan every minute using the separate proposer role; six-hour calculation remains.

title: Raced permissionless harvest aborts remaining fee-cycle work
description: Locker/Aero readiness is read before submission; another caller can harvest in between. The resulting cooldown revert is fatal, unlike an optional legacy estimate failure.
impact: That run skips subsequent legacy collection, splitting and swapping; repeated interference can delay the pipeline.
exploit_scenario: An adversary or benign second bot calls a ready harvester between the readiness read and transaction estimation/inclusion. Local injected estimate-revert PoC confirms no later steps execute. No live attack attempted.
recommendation: On a conclusively unsent cooldown revert, re-read source state and continue independent work. For broadcast/reverted/ambiguous transactions reconcile receipt and nonce before continuing.
remediation: Continue after proven unsent or exact-receipt-reconciled cooldown races; ambiguous sends remain fatal.

title: Known active unpaid rewards can remain green in monitor
description: Staleness checks only pending rounds; a known active unpaid round is reported ok without a last-progress age.
impact: Operators may not be alerted that payout execution stopped.
exploit_scenario: Thirty days later, an active known round with 100 unpaid and a fresh price floor returns overall ok.
recommendation: Track activation/last payment age and bot heartbeats, including absence of new rounds.
remediation: Persist per-round progress; unknown-age and six-hour-stalled rounds report attention; corrupt/regressed observations fail closed.
